name: Dune
description: Loads the result of a saved Dune query, public or your own: its latest stored result, or a fresh execution. Every page of rows is read, with numbers and dates typed from Dune's column types.
introductoryText:
![Dune](data:image/png;base64,
)

Loads the result of a saved query on **Dune** (dune.com), any public query or a private one your account can see.

**How to set it up**
1. Create an API key in your Dune account's API settings and enter it.
2. Enter the query ID: the number after `/queries/` in the query's address (`241` for https://dune.com/queries/241/388), or paste the whole address.
3. Choose **Retrieve latest query results** (reads the result Dune last stored, no new run) or **Execute and retrieve latest results** (runs the query now and waits for it).

The **Results** output holds the rows, with Dune's number, date and true/false columns typed; the **Execution** output is one record about the run (state, times, row count). Executions and results use Dune credits.

options.name: duneApiKey
options.title: Dune API key
options.description: An API key from your Dune account's API settings. The block can read the queries this key's account can see.

options.name: queryId
options.title: Query ID
options.description: The number after /queries/ in the query's address (241 for https://dune.com/queries/241/388), or the whole address.

options.name: mode
options.title: Query mode
options.description: Retrieve: read the result Dune last stored for the query (fails if it was never run, has changed since, or the result has expired). Execute: run the query now, wait for it, then read the result.

choices.title: Execute and retrieve latest results
choices.description: Runs the query now (uses execution credits) and waits for it to finish.

choices.title: Retrieve latest query results
choices.description: Reads the result Dune stored from the last run; no new execution.

options.name: performance
options.title: Engine size
options.description: For Execute only: the Dune engine to run on. Medium is Dune's default; Large has more resources for heavy queries and can use more credits.

blockOutputs.label: Execution
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record about the run: Execution ID, Query ID, State, Submitted, Started, Ended, Expires, Rows.

blockOutputs.label: Results
blockOutputs.tooltip: The query's rows, every page, with the columns in Dune's order and typed from Dune's column types.
